environment_fingerprint.resolved_is_NOT_used: The resolved path is recorded for provenance ONLY. Invoking it drops the venv, because a venv derives sys.prefix from argv[0]'s location plus pyvenv.cfg.
environment_fingerprint.rss_units_note: ru_maxrss is BYTES on Darwin, KILOBYTES on Linux. Each row carries rss_raw + rss_unit alongside rss_mb; do not compare rss_mb across platforms without checking rss_unit.
environment_fingerprint.rss_scope: RUSAGE_SELF measured INSIDE each child, i.e. per-process peak. NOT RUSAGE_CHILDREN, which is a running max across all children.
environment_fingerprint.timing_method: time.perf_counter() in the PARENT around subprocess.run of a fresh interpreter: wall-clock cold start including process spawn and import, single sample, no warm cache control.
environment_fingerprint.timing_caveats: Single unrepeated sample per library, same-machine, other processes not quiesced. Treat as order-of-magnitude only.
environment_fingerprint.isolation_flags: -I (isolated: no PYTHONPATH, no user site, no script dir)
